title: Relationship Banking Schedule: the Proportion of a Disputed Amount Credited Temporarily
content:
The proportion credited on a billing dispute raised on a card under Personal Credit Cards is read from the cardholder's Personal Checking relationship together with the card payments that have posted to that card account.

| What the records show | Credited proportion |
|---|---|
| An active Premier Checking or Private Client Checking account, and at least 6 card payments posted to this card account in the last twelve months | 95 percent |
| An active checking account whose tier is neither Premier Checking nor Private Client Checking, and at least 6 card payments posted to this card account in the last twelve months | 85 percent |
| Neither of those | no adjustment to the credited proportion is made |

**Both parts of a tier.** Each tier requires the checking holding and the payment count together. A cardholder holding an active Premier Checking account with 3 card payments in the last twelve months meets neither tier; a cardholder holding an active Interest Checking account with 7 card payments meets the second, Interest Checking being neither Premier Checking nor Private Client Checking.

**On the count and the holding.** The payment count is read as at least, so exactly 6 card payments in the last twelve months satisfies either tier's second part. A cardholder with no active checking account at all satisfies neither tier, and a cardholder whose only checking account is closed is in the same position, the holding being tested as active.
